before: A rich paste left the local caret at the start of the pasted content.
after: A rich paste leaves the local caret at the end of the pasted content. insertFragment reports that end as its committed caret, and applyFragmentPaste returns it as end.
reason: The caret and the paste end are local to the pasting client. The pasted blocks, the resource merge, the replicated primitive journal, text offsets, and package serialization stay unchanged. A re-keyed landing paragraph resolves through the local paragraph order.
